verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe real-time observability features like watching the terminal execute commands with live output logs, jumping in during interactive browsing, and taking over in Devin's IDE mid-task, all indicating a live view of the agent's current activity/status. Missing for 10: no explicit dedicated 'status dashboard' documentation and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the real-time monitoring UX beyond vendor docs.
